strings.notes: US 0697/0; 尚文 = 0719 #663 Stuart (US contact Fisherman Kyle)

strings.zh: 为了铭记我们这场{NEWLINE}精彩的对战,{CLEAR}我们相互交换一下{CLEAR}电话号码怎么样？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: So I don’t forget just how great{NEWLINE}it is to battle with you, how about{CLEAR}we exchange phone numbers? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 这样就行了,{NEWLINE}我不会忘记你的！
strings.en: Awesome! I definitely won’t forget{NEWLINE}about you now!

strings.zh: 哈哈！果然{NEWLINE}你还是想和我{CLEAR}交换电话号码啊。{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Oh! I see you’ve changed your mind{NEWLINE}about exchanging phone numbers{CLEAR}with me!{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 哎？莫非你现在{NEWLINE}就在我附近了？{SCROLL}要是你想聊天的话,{NEWLINE}直接找我好了。
strings.en: Hm? Wait, let me guess. You’re nearby,{NEWLINE}aren’t you?{SCROLL}If you want to talk to me, why don’t{NEWLINE}you do it in person?

strings.zh: 我的{VAR:0100:10}{NEWLINE}很努力的！{SCROLL}我要说的⋯⋯就这些！
strings.en: My {VAR:0100:10} works really hard!{SCROLL}End of report!

strings.zh: 对了,昨天我打倒了{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11}！{SCROLL}我要说的⋯⋯就这些！
strings.en: You know... Yesterday, we beat a{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11}!{SCROLL}End of report!

strings.zh: 就在刚才,{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11}逃掉了。{SCROLL}我要说的⋯⋯就这些！
strings.en: Oh no... Just a little while ago, a{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11} got away...{SCROLL}End of report!

strings.zh: 你还记得吗？{SCROLL}我和你战斗的那一瞬间！{SCROLL}要不要再来一次对战,{NEWLINE}找回当时的那份感动？{SCROLL}我在{VAR:0104:3}等你。
strings.en: Do you remember?{SCROLL}The moment we first battled!{SCROLL}I want to battle with you again, to{NEWLINE}relive that tense moment!{SCROLL}I’m waiting on {VAR:0104:3}.

strings.zh: 你还记得吗？{NEWLINE}我和你约好了对战的！{SCROLL}我在{VAR:0104:3}等你,{NEWLINE}赶快来。
strings.en: Do you remember?{NEWLINE}We had plans to battle!{SCROLL}I’m waiting for you on{NEWLINE}{VAR:0104:3}, so hurry up!

strings.zh: 是吗,{NEWLINE}你终于想向我请教{CLEAR}垂钓的要领了啊。{SCROLL}好吧。{NEWLINE}让我想想该说些什么。{SCROLL}首先⋯⋯{NEWLINE}你要面向水面,{CLEAR}深吸一口气,{CLEAR}握好钓竿,{CLEAR}向着你要下杆的地方,{CLEAR}嗖地一下甩出去！{SCROLL}此时你一旦松手,{NEWLINE}钓竿就会跟这飞出去,{CLEAR}所以一定要握紧钓竿！{SCROLL}浮标和鱼线沉下去后{NEWLINE}先不要动,等待一会！{SCROLL}不过,这时候你要是鼻子痒痒的话{NEWLINE}也可以稍微小动一下。{SCROLL}然后,等你听到噗通的碰钩声后,{NEWLINE}就嗞~~地赶忙收杆！{SCROLL}记住了吗？是先噗通再嗞,{NEWLINE}不是先嗞再噗通,{CLEAR}当然先啪咔再唰{CLEAR}或者咕咚了再嗖⋯⋯{CLEAR}⋯⋯哎？这电话⋯⋯{CLEAR}没声了⋯⋯喂⋯⋯听得见吗？{CLEAR}喂⋯⋯喂⋯⋯⋯⋯
strings.en: So, you’ve finally decided you want to{NEWLINE}learn the secrets of fishing from me.{SCROLL}All right. Let me think{NEWLINE}about what to tell you.{SCROLL}First... face the water, take a{NEWLINE}deep breath, grip your rod, aim{CLEAR}at the spot where you want to{CLEAR}fish, and WHOOSH! Cast your line!{SCROLL}If you let go at that moment, your rod{NEWLINE}will fly off with it, so hold on tight!{SCROLL}Once the float and line sink,{NEWLINE}don’t move. Just wait a while!{SCROLL}Although, if your nose itches, I{NEWLINE}suppose you can move a tiny bit.{SCROLL}Then, when you hear the PLOP of{NEWLINE}a bite, ZZZIP! Reel it in fast!{SCROLL}Got it? First PLOP, then ZZZIP. Not{NEWLINE}ZZZIP, then PLOP. And of course,{CLEAR}it could be CLACK then SWISH, or{CLEAR}GLUG then WHOOSH... ...Huh? The{CLEAR}phone... went quiet... Hello...?{CLEAR}Can you hear me? Hello... Hello...
